note: C11 (2026-10-01): what this project KNOWS about each provider label used in affiliate_programs.provider. A capability is true / false only with evidence from this repository (code that exercises it) or a human verification record; otherwise it is "unknown". Nothing here is inferred from public knowledge of an ASP. Changing a value needs evidence.

capability_keys.subid_in_tracking_url: the provider accepts a per-click / per-placement reference on the tracking URL (SubID, clickref)
capability_keys.click_reference_in_commission_report: conversions come back with that reference
capability_keys.commission_import_api: this project reads conversions through an API
capability_keys.commission_report_manual: conversions are only visible in the provider dashboard (a human copies them)
capability_keys.program_filter_in_import: the import can be limited to one program

click_reference_in_commission_report.evidence: code: app/affiliate/make_commission_rows.py reads no click reference (C10-A, attribution_readiness.KNOWN_IMPORTERS)

program_filter_in_import.evidence: code: the import reads every commission (attribution_readiness.KNOWN_IMPORTERS)

commission_import_api.evidence: code: no PartnerStack importer or credential exists in this repository
code: no Impact importer or credential exists in this repository
code: no FirstPromoter importer or credential exists in this repository

direct.kind: the vendor's own program (no network); capabilities differ per vendor

commission_import_api.evidence: code: no importer for any direct program except Make (listed separately)

multi_network.kind: offered through more than one network; which one is used is not recorded
